name: ZeroStorefront
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; San Mateo, CA, USA; Remote
long_description: We connect applications to drive more orders and better customer experiences for restaurants. The typical restaurant now uses more than two dozen different applications to run their business. Specifically, we connect, warehouse and route the data to improve analytics, marketing, operations and finance.  Our customers include brands like Frank Pepe’s, Halal Guys, Wings Over and more.
one_liner: #1 Data platform for restaurants. Acquired by Thanx

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I'm an engineer, founder and investor. Today, I invest in early-stage software companies. I started my career as the founder and CEO of FanGo (TS S10), building restaurant mobile ordering. In 2011, FanGo was acquired by GrubHub, and I became the Head of Innovation there. In 2019, I co-founded ZeroStorefront, a data analytics platform for restaurants, which Thanx acquired in 2022. I teach at Stanford and live in the Bay area.

news.title: Thanx to Acquire Marketing Automator ZeroStorefront - Food On Demand
